tips.text: Cast Sonic Wave first, then recast Resonating Strike to close the gap. It deals more damage the lower the target's health is.
Weave a basic attack between spells. Flurry gives you Attack Speed and returns Energy, so you can keep casting.
Self-cast Safeguard, then use Iron Will on camps. The healing from Omnivamp keeps your health up while you clear.
Use Tempest on a fighter, then recast Cripple to leave them slowed so they can't escape or reach you easily.
Use Sonic Wave before Dragon's Rage, so you can chase the target with Resonating Strike. Aim the kick so the target hits other enemies.
Use Safeguard on an ally, minion or ward to dash to them. It shields you and your ally if the target is a champion, which makes it a good escape.
Sonic Wave stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion or monster in the way takes the hit. Line it up on a clear path to your target.

combos.name: Ward hop
combos.when: You need to escape, chase, or cross a wall quickly.
combos.text: Place a ward and Safeguard to it right away. Safeguard targets a ward near the cursor, so it works on a freshly placed ward.

combos.name: Resonating Strike into ward hop
combos.when: You have landed Sonic Wave and want to dash in, then retreat or reposition.
combos.text: After the second Q lands, ward hop away to a ward, ally or minion. Safeguard can be cast during the dash, which makes this a quick kite-back.

combos.name: Q into kick
combos.when: The target is at range and you want a kick plus a follow-up.
combos.text: Use the first Q to mark them, then kick, then recast Q to follow the knocked-back target. This follows Riot's tip to use Sonic Wave before Dragon's Rage.

tips.text: Fight Aatrox early, before he has items. Use Sonic Wave, then Resonating Strike to close in, and finish with a kick from Dragon's Rage.
Use Cripple after Tempest when Aatrox tries to get away or reach you. It leaves him slowed, so you can catch him or walk out of his range.
Aatrox's Infernal Chains pull him back to the center of the chain's area if he stays inside it. Walk out sideways or toward him, or use Safeguard to dash away.
Dodge The Darkin Blade sideways. Its hit zones show before it lands, and Aatrox's best damage comes from the tip of each swing.
Cast Iron Will in a long fight to heal back some of Aatrox's damage. It gives you omnivamp.
Hold Dragon's Rage for when Aatrox has no escape. Kicking him into his teammates knocks them up, but he will heal back if he gets to use his ultimate.
Open with Sonic Wave, then Resonating Strike to close the gap if Ambessa backs away. Aim carefully, since the wave stops at the first enemy it hits.
Use Cripple after Tempest hits her, so she is slowed when she tries to dash onto you or run away.
Ambessa is weak to magic damage, but Lee Sin deals mostly physical damage. Weave basic attacks between abilities so Flurry keeps your energy up in a long fight.
Use Safeguard on a ward or minion to jump away when Ambessa dives. It also gives you a shield.
Kick Ambessa with Dragon's Rage toward your team, and bring her into other enemies so they get knocked up too.
Stay out of Amumu's range when his ultimate is ready. Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns everyone close, and Lee Sin can't fight while stunned.
Amumu is hard to hurt with physical damage. Use Tempest / Cripple for magic damage and skip long auto-attack trades.
Bandage Toss is a line that ends on the first unit it hits. Keep a minion between you and Amumu, or keep moving.
Don't stand in Despair for long. It deals more damage the more Health you have.
Hit Bel'Veth with Sonic Wave, then follow with Resonating Strike to stay on her when she tries to dash away with Void Surge.
Use Tempest and then Cripple when she dives in; the slow cuts her chase and her attacks.
Fight her early, before she has stacked Lavender from takedowns and her attack speed grows out of control.
Kick her with Dragon's Rage away from your team, or into her allies, when she commits to a fight.
Do not stand still next to a corpse after a kill; she can dash to the Void Coral with Endless Banquet and explode on you.
Dodge Brand's Sear and Pillar of Flame. His combo cannot begin until one lands, and Sear stuns only if you are already ablaze.
Close the gap with Sonic Wave and then Resonating Strike. Brand is weak up close, so stay on him.
Use Cripple on Brand once you are in reach to slow him, so he cannot kite you.
Use Safeguard to dodge into your allies or a ward and gain a shield before Brand's burst lands.
Walk away from your teammates when you see Pyroclasm start. Its first missile is slow, so you have time to step out of its bounces.
Fight Briar when she is already hurt; Resonating Strike hits much harder on low Health targets.
Land Tempest, then Cripple her when she charges in; a slowed Briar is easier to kite and trade with.
Hold Dragon's Rage for when Briar is in her frenzy. She cannot control her movement, so kick her toward your team.
Use Safeguard and Iron Will in a long fight; the shield and omnivamp offset her bleed healing.
Keep your distance when Briar's Chilling Scream is charged near a wall. A full charge knocks you back and stuns you.
Hit Sonic Wave first, then Resonating Strike to close the gap, so Darius cannot just walk away from you.
Use Tempest and its recast to leave Darius slowed when he tries to chase you, or when you want to leave a fight.
Fight Darius in short trades and back off before he stacks Hemorrhage. His damage and healing grow the longer a fight goes on.
Kick Darius with Dragon's Rage toward your team, or into his allies, so the collision hurts them too.
Stay out of Apprehend's cone. When it is on cooldown, step in and trade.
Use Safeguard to dash to an ally or ward and get out of Darius's reach once he has committed to a fight.
Use Sonic Wave from a distance, then Resonating Strike to close on Diana before she can use Pale Cascade orbs to trade back.
Cast Cripple after Tempest when Diana dashes in, so she is slowed and can't easily stay on you or escape.
Stay out of Crescent Strike's path. Once you are marked, Diana can use Lunar Rush on you again right away.
Diana deals magic damage, so Iron Will's healing won't blunt her burst much. Use Safeguard to shield yourself when she dives.
Kick Diana with Dragon's Rage into her teammates, so they are knocked up and take extra damage.
Hit Mundo with Sonic Wave only when it will land; he will not be stopped by crowd control and his Infected Bonesaw punishes a long chase.
Dragon's Rage on Mundo is often wasted, since his passive resists the root. Save the kick for his teammates.
Step on the dropped canister yourself to destroy it before Mundo can heal from it.
Use Cripple after Tempest to slow Mundo and stay out of his reach; he is tanky, so do not trade while Heart Zapper is charging.
Mundo is vulnerable to magic damage but heals through it quickly, so burst him fast after Maximum Dosage starts.
Hit Sonic Wave first, then follow with Resonating Strike to close the gap before Ekko can slip away.
Kick Ekko with Dragon's Rage while his Chronobreak is on cooldown; he has no way to rewind out of a fight then.
Use Cripple after Tempest to keep Ekko slowed so he cannot easily run or reposition.
Ekko is weak to physical burst, so Lee Sin should chain his abilities with basic attacks to kill him fast, before Ekko can use his tools.
Step out of Parallel Convergence once it appears; being stunned inside it lets Ekko chain a kill onto you.
Stay spread out from Evelynn's target. Her Allure charm is dangerous, so protect any marked ally or put allies between you and her.
Tempest reveals enemies for a few seconds, so use it to spot Evelynn when she is near. Cripple then leaves her slowed.
Evelynn is fragile and takes your physical damage well. Use Sonic Wave and then Resonating Strike to catch her when she steps out of the shadows.
Save Dragon's Rage for when Evelynn commits to a fight. Her Last Caress can make her untargetable, so do not waste the kick.
Hit Fiddlesticks with Sonic Wave and follow with Resonating Strike; he is fragile and you can reach him fast.
Keep wards out and watch for him standing still as a scarecrow; his next ability will fear you.
Don't walk into Reap; being silenced stops your dashes and abilities.
Use Dragon's Rage on Fiddlesticks before he gets his abilities off; he has no escape once kicked.
Break away from Crowstorm's area when you see him channel; use Safeguard to leave.
Hit Sonic Wave on Graves, then follow with Resonating Strike to close the gap; he has no way to stop the dash once it starts.
Use Tempest and then Cripple when Graves tries to back away; the slow keeps him in your reach.
Fight Graves up close. He is a marksman, so stay on him and kick him with Dragon's Rage once his dash is spent.
Do not walk into Smoke Screen to chase; you can't see out of it and you'll be slowed. Wait for him to leave it or fight at its edge.
Use Safeguard on a minion or ward to close in or dodge End of the Line, and shield yourself when you commit.
Hit Sonic Wave first, then follow with Resonating Strike. Gwen's Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable, so use the dash before she can cast it.
Use Cripple on Gwen after Tempest hits. She needs her Skip 'n Slash dash and attacks to deal damage, so a slowed Gwen has a hard time with both.
Gwen deals magic damage, so Iron Will's omnivamp helps you sustain through her trades.
Gank or fight her before she has attacked a few times. Her damage builds up through attacks, so jump on her early.
Wait for Gwen to use Hallowed Mist before you kick her with Dragon's Rage. Cast it while she is outside the mist, and knock her into her teammates.
Hit Sonic Wave first, then follow with Resonating Strike to close the gap when Hecarim tries to run from you.
Use Cripple after Tempest to leave Hecarim slowed, so he cannot easily build up speed for his charge.
Hecarim is not very durable, so look for a burst fight and kick him with Dragon's Rage once you have a lead.
Do not fight inside Spirit of Dread for long; he heals from damage taken. Trade in short bursts and step out.
Weave basic attacks between your abilities with Flurry so you hit fast and keep your Energy up in a short brawl.
Hit Sonic Wave on Ivern, then follow with Resonating Strike to close the gap before he slips into brush.
Use Tempest to reveal Ivern when he hides in brush, then slow him with Cripple so he can't get away.
Look for a gank when Ivern is alone. He is a weak fighter by himself, so Dragon's Rage can finish him once his friends are away.
Be careful fighting near Daisy. Her third hit on you launches a shockwave, so kill Ivern first or fight away from her.
Keep moving when Rootcaller is aimed at you, because it roots the first enemy it hits. Dodge it, then jump in.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan's Demacian Standard and Jarvan himself, or Dragon Strike will knock you up.
Use Safeguard or Resonating Strike to dash out of Cataclysm's arena; Jarvan's terrain does not stop movement abilities.
Hit Jarvan with Tempest, then follow with Cripple so he is slowed and cannot chain his combo.
Do not hit Jax with basic attacks while Counter Strike is up; wait for it to end. Cast Safeguard to dash away before the stun lands.
Jax gets stronger the longer he keeps attacking, so use Tempest and its slow to break his chain of attacks.
Jax can take a lot of physical damage, so lean on the magic damage in Tempest and avoid long fights with attacks alone.
Sonic Wave first, then Resonating Strike to follow him when he leaps away.
Hit Sonic Wave first, then follow with Resonating Strike. Jayce's Thundering Blow can knock you off course, so close the gap before he swings.
Jayce is strongest early, so be careful about fighting him alone in the early game. Look for ganks when he has used his cooldowns.
Use Tempest and then Cripple when Jayce jumps in with To the Skies!, so he is slowed and can't easily get away or follow you.
Jayce takes magic damage poorly in cannon form, but Tempest deals magic damage and reveals him. Use it to find him when he hides.
Weave basic attacks between your abilities so Flurry gives you attack speed and returns Energy during a long fight.
Close in with Sonic Wave and Resonating Strike when Karthus is alone; his Wall of Pain slows you, so don't dash through it.
Kill Karthus fast and then step away from his body; he keeps casting after he dies.
Use Safeguard to dash out of range of his Lay Waste, and cast Iron Will to heal back what his damage took.
Stay out of Defile's range, because it drains your health while you fight, and Cripple lets you leave his reach.
Stay healthy before level 6; Requiem hits you from anywhere on the map, and you can't dodge it once it lands.
Land Sonic Wave on Kayn, then follow with Resonating Strike; it hits harder the lower his health is, so use it to finish him.
Cast Tempest and then Cripple when Kayn tries to dash in or run away, so he is slowed.
Kick Kayn with Dragon's Rage when he is committed to a fight, and knock him into his teammates for extra damage.
Use Safeguard and then Iron Will in a fight against Kayn; the shield and healing help you win the trade.
Kayn is weak early; look for a gank or fight on him before he reaches a stronger form.
Stay near your minions or allies when you fight Kha'Zix, so Taste Their Fear doesn't get its extra damage on an Isolated target.
Hit Kha'Zix with Sonic Wave, then follow with Resonating Strike to close the gap when he tries to leave.
Use Tempest on him, then recast Cripple so he is slowed and can't easily leap away or reset the fight.
Look for the fight when Kha'Zix has used Leap and Void Assault. He is much easier to catch without them.
Use Safeguard on yourself or a ward to get the shield before Kha'Zix jumps on you, and recast Iron Will to heal while you trade.
Kindred is fragile. Land Sonic Wave, then follow with Resonating Strike to dash onto her and burst her before she can kite.
Kick her with Dragon's Rage when she dives in or tries to kite. It roots her while you cast, then knocks her back.
Use Tempest, then Cripple, to keep her slowed so she can't walk away from your attacks.
Don't kick her while Lamb's Respite is up. Nobody inside can die, so wait until it ends.
Dance of Arrows lets her dash away. Hold Resonating Strike until after she uses it so you can follow her.
Hit Sonic Wave on Lillia, then use Resonating Strike to close the gap before she can kite away with her Move Speed.
Use Cripple after Tempest so Lillia is slowed and cannot run you down or escape.
Kick Lillia with Dragon's Rage when she is out of position; she is a fragile fighter and the damage hurts.
Take the shield from Safeguard when you walk into her Swirlseed; it softens her poke and trades.
Save Dragon's Rage for when Master Yi has used Alpha Strike or is caught after it ends; he cannot be targeted while jumping.
Slow Master Yi with Cripple before he activates Highlander; once it is on, he can't be slowed.
Root Master Yi with Dragon's Rage to stop him in his tracks when he is running at you with Highlander active.
Hit Master Yi a few times with Sonic Wave and Tempest so he must spend mana on Meditate; keep pressure on him while it is on cooldown.
Wukong often leaves a clone with Warrior Trickster after Nimbus Strike. Wait a moment before you commit Sonic Wave so you hit the real one.
Use Cripple after Tempest when Wukong dives in. The slow helps you get out, or lets you keep hitting him.
Don't fight Wukong in a long brawl. Stone Skin makes him tougher the more he hits you, so trade in short bursts and back off.
Cast Iron Will when you start trading with Wukong. The omnivamp helps you recover during the fight.
Hit Naafiri with Sonic Wave, then follow with Resonating Strike; it hurts more the lower her Health is.
Use Cripple after Tempest hits so Naafiri is slowed and cannot easily dash away from you.
Kick Naafiri with Dragon's Rage once she has committed. It cannot be cast on her while she is untargetable.
Use Safeguard on a ward or minion to shield yourself when Naafiri jumps on you with her pack.
Land Sonic Wave on Nidalee, then use Resonating Strike right away to close the gap before she can run or pounce off.
Use Tempest then Cripple when she dives in or runs; the slowed Nidalee is easier to catch and kick.
Stay out of brush when you chase her. She moves faster there and toward you, so she can slip away or jump on you.
Kick Nidalee with Dragon's Rage at low health to finish her. It cannot be cast from afar, so walk up to her first.
Look for the Bushwhack traps before you walk into brush or chase her. Walking over one hurts and marks you as Hunted.
Bait out Shroud of Darkness with a cheap ability before you commit Sonic Wave or Dragon's Rage.
Use Cripple after Tempest when Nocturne feared you or dives; the slowed enemy is easier to fight and escape.
Break the tether of Unspeakable Horror by moving out of range, or dash away with Safeguard before the fear lands.
Stay near your team when Nocturne casts Paranoia; his dash can only pick an enemy champion.
Follow Nocturne's Duskbringer trail by watching it; it reveals where he walked, even in fog.
Land Sonic Wave on Nunu, then follow with Resonating Strike to close the gap.
Sidestep or Safeguard away from the Biggest Snowball Ever!. It turns slowly, so a sharp turn dodges it.
Use Tempest then Cripple on Nunu to slow him. It cuts his chase and his chances to land Snowball Barrage.
Do not walk into the Absolute Zero blizzard. Interrupt it early or leave its area to take less damage.
Nunu's Consume heals him, so burst him quickly rather than poking. Magic damage hurts you less than expected, so avoid long trades.
Fire Sonic Wave at Pantheon from range, then follow with Resonating Strike. Close in when he isn't charging Comet Spear.
Don't hit Pantheon from the front while Aegis Assault is up; he ignores damage from that direction. Wait it out or get behind him.
Use Tempest and Cripple when Pantheon jumps in, so he is slowed and you can fight or leave.
Kick Pantheon with Dragon's Rage toward your teammates when he commits, or into his allies to knock them up.
Use Safeguard to shield yourself or an ally when Shield Vault is coming. It doesn't stop the stun.
Move away from the target area when Pantheon starts Grand Starfall; it gives a long warning.
Hit Qiyana with Sonic Wave, then follow with Resonating Strike to close the gap before she can dash away.
Use Tempest then Cripple when she dives in, so she is slowed and can't easily line up her next move.
Kick her with Dragon's Rage when she steps near you. She is rooted while the kick winds up, so she can't dash away.
Use Safeguard on a ally or ward to shield yourself when she stuns or bursts you.
Weave basic attacks between your spells. Flurry gives you attack speed and energy back, so you can keep trading with her.
Hit Rammus with magic damage from Tempest / Cripple when his Defensive Ball Curl is off; he is much weaker out of that stance.
Do not attack Rammus while Defensive Ball Curl is up; it hurts you for each attack and his armor is high.
Stay out of Frenzying Taunt range before you dash in with Resonating Strike; being taunted ends your combo.
Use Safeguard to run from Powerball; once he is rolling he catches you quickly.
Aim Sonic Wave carefully; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way blocks it. Follow with Resonating Strike once it lands.
Use Cripple after Tempest when Rek'Sai tries to run or tunnel away. It leaves her slowed.
Hit Rek'Sai with magic damage when you can. Tempest ignores the physical defenses she may build.
Fight when Rek'Sai's Fury is low. A full Fury makes her Furious Bite hit much harder, and it becomes true damage.
Keep Dragon's Rage for when Rek'Sai is low. Her Void Rush dive makes her untargetable, so don't kick into it.
Fight Rengar when his Ferocity bar is low; at full Ferocity his next ability is empowered, so back off then.
Stay out of brush when Rengar is near; he leaps from it with his basic attack.
Watch for the marker over you when Rengar uses Thrill of the Hunt, then turn and fight him instead of running.
Use Tempest and then Cripple to leave Rengar slowed when he dives in, then trade while he closes the gap.
Use Dragon's Rage on Rengar once he commits; it knocks him back and he cannot leap in again right away.
Rengar's Battle Roar damage is magic and it heals him from damage just taken, so burst him fast instead of trickling damage.
Use Sonic Wave before Dragon's Rage so you can chase the target with Resonating Strike.
Cripple will not slow Sejuani while her Frost Armor is up, so hit her when it is down or use Cripple on her allies instead.
Hit Sejuani with magic damage when you can, since Tempest and your other abilities struggle against her armor.
Stay away from her melee allies when she is nearby; four hits on you let her stun you with Permafrost.
Save Safeguard to dash away after Arctic Assault lands, and shield yourself when you are caught.
Stay spread out of the stealth: Shaco must reach your back for his big hit, so face him and use Tempest to reveal him.
Watch for boxes near the camps and paths; a box is untargetable until revealed, so Tempest reveals the area first.
Do not chase Shaco blindly into fog; run in with Resonating Strike only when no box is likely near his path.
Use Dragon's Rage on Shaco right after he commits with Deceive; he cannot easily use it again to escape.
Kill the Hallucinate clone away from you; it explodes into boxes when it dies, so do not hit it while you stand beside it.
Use Cripple on Shaco when he commits so he is slowed and cannot easily escape or reset.
Hit Sonic Wave on Shyvana, then follow with Resonating Strike; it hurts more the lower her health is, so save it to finish a fight.
Use Cripple after Tempest hits so Shyvana is slowed. It makes her harder to catch you and easier to kite in a fight.
Fight her while she is still in human form. Her power builds from landing attacks, so poke and step back instead of trading evenly.
Kick her with Dragon's Rage into her teammates while she is in dragon form; she is bulky, so the crash does extra damage.
Safeguard to an ally or ward to shield yourself and close the gap or escape when Shyvana turns on you.
Use Sonic Wave to find Skarner, then follow with Resonating Strike to close in before he can set up his boulder attacks.
Skarner is tanky and sticks to you, so land Tempest and then slow him with Cripple to keep him from locking onto you in a long fight.
Skarner's Ixtal's Impact is stopped by a knock up, so save Dragon's Rage for when he charges at you or an ally.
Skarner relies on magic damage in Seismic Bastion, so use Safeguard to shield yourself and an ally when he closes in.
Start trades with Sonic Wave, then follow with Resonating Strike. Sylas is a mage and he can't easily punish you while you are on top of him.
Use Tempest and then its recast to leave Sylas slowed, so he can't easily dash away or reach you.
Weave basic attacks between your spells. Flurry gives you Attack Speed and returns Energy, so you can keep trading.
Don't fight Sylas when he is low on health and ready to use Kingslayer; he heals more the lower he is. Finish him with burst, not a long trade.
Kick Sylas with Dragon's Rage when he has no ultimate to steal from you. Use it on him before he grabs yours in a fight.
Cast Sonic Wave before Dragon's Rage so you can chase with Resonating Strike if Talon tries to slip away.
Hit Tempest, then recast it to leave Talon slowed. It makes his jumps and escapes much easier to catch.
Talon deals only physical damage, so use Safeguard on yourself or an ally before he jumps in. The shield and Iron Will's healing soften his burst.
Kick Talon with Dragon's Rage when he is committed to a fight, not while Shadow Assault can still hide him.
Keep Trundle off his Frozen Domain. Fight him away from the ice, where he is slower and attacks more slowly.
Do not walk into a long fight with Trundle. Subjugate steals your resistances and heals him, so burst him and get out.
Leave Pillar of Ice quickly. It slows you, so do not chase him through it with Resonating Strike.
Use Cripple after Tempest hits Trundle so he is slowed and cannot easily stay on you or run away.
Dodge his Chomp or trade right after it is spent. It cuts your attack damage, which weakens your fight.
Hit Sonic Wave from range, then use Resonating Strike to close the gap; Udyr has few ways to hit you back at range.
Use Tempest and then its Recast to leave Udyr slowed when he runs at you, so he can't easily stay on you.
Keep your distance while Udyr's Blazing Stampede is active. His attacks dash to you and stun, so don't let him land the first hit.
Hold Dragon's Rage until Udyr has used up his shield, or kick him into his teammates. Collided enemies are knocked up and take extra damage.
Fight Udyr in short trades and back out, since his Iron Mantle shield and healing make long fights favor him. Use Safeguard to leave or reposition.
Use Sonic Wave before Dragon's Rage so Resonating Strike can chase Vi down. Kick her toward your team, not away.
Fight Vi in short trades. Her third hit on you shreds Armor and speeds her up, so step back before it lands.
When Vi chases you, use Cripple after Tempest so she is slowed and cannot catch you.
Do not try to dodge Cease and Desist by being pushed or pulled away. Vi cannot be stopped while she dashes, so fight her once the dash ends.
Take a Safeguard shield before you trade with Vi. Use Iron Will to heal back from the fight.
Fight Viego early in the game, before he has items and kills to snowball from. Start trades with Sonic Wave, then follow up with Resonating Strike.
Use Cripple after Tempest when Viego tries to run or chase, so he is slowed.
Viego's Spectral Maw can stun you, so stay out of a straight line with him when he is charging it.
Kill Viego fast when he is in a fight. If you kill him, you stop his own Mist Wraith plays.
Don't let a teammate die near Viego. He can eat the Mist Wraith to heal and take their body for a while.
Fight Volibear before he has built up The Relentless Storm; once his attacks chain lightning, he wins longer trades.
Kite away from the slow of Sky Splitter by walking out of the circle; the bolt lands after a delay and you can see it coming.
Use Tempest then Cripple when Volibear runs at you; the slow stops his pounce from landing easily.
Do not use Dragon's Rage while Volibear is in his big form with spare health; the kick does less than you want. Look for his squishy teammates instead.
Hit Sonic Wave first, then dash in with Resonating Strike to stay on Volibear when he tries to leave.
Do not run in a straight line from Warwick when he is low on health. Hold-casting Jaws of the Beast follows dashes, so a dash is not a safe escape.
Avoid fights that leave you under half health. Blood Hunt lets Warwick sense you and chase you down fast.
Use Cripple on Warwick to leave him slowed when you disengage.
Save Dragon's Rage for when Warwick commits, since his Infinite Duress will suppress you if it lands. Do not fight him while he is healing at low health.
Use Iron Will after Safeguard when you trade with Warwick. The omnivamp helps you keep up against his healing.
Land Sonic Wave, then use Resonating Strike to close in on Xin Zhao. Dragon's Rage is better kept for when he commits.
Use Tempest and Cripple when Xin Zhao dives on you. The slow helps you escape or turn the fight around.
Break up his Three Talon Strike combo by moving away before the third hit. That hit knocks you up.
Don't kick Xin Zhao's team with Dragon's Rage right after he lands Crescent Guard. He takes no damage from outside its sweep, so wait it out.
Hit Zac with Sonic Wave, then follow with Resonating Strike; the dash adds more damage as his health drops.
Zac leaves goo chunks when he hits you. Step on them to destroy them so he cannot heal from them.
Use Cripple after Tempest hits so Zac is slowed and cannot easily chase or escape.
Zac is weak to magic damage but has Cell Division. When he splits, kill every bloblet or he comes back.
Hit Zac while he charges Elastic Slingshot. Stuns and knock ups cancel it, so use Dragon's Rage to kick him away.
Hit Sonic Wave on Zed, then follow with Resonating Strike to close the gap; it hurts more the lower his health is.
Use Cripple after Tempest connects so Zed is slowed and cannot easily slip away.
Save Dragon's Rage for when Zed has jumped onto you or a teammate with Death Mark, and kick him away from the fight.
Zed's Contempt for the Weak hits hard when you are low on health, so back off before he gets to hit you.
Zed's Razor Shuriken hits you from his shadow too. Step out of line with Safeguard to a ward or ally when he throws.
Hit Zyra with Sonic Wave, then follow with Resonating Strike to land on her before she can aim Grasping Roots.
Zyra's plants are weak to quick fights. Dive her when few seeds are around and kill her before any plants grow.
Step over her seeds when you can; enemy champions destroy them by walking on them, so she has fewer plants to fight with.
Use Cripple after Tempest when you leave a fight. The slow helps you get away from her or chase her.
Zyra is fragile. Dragon's Rage hits hard against her, so save it to kill her once she has used Grasping Roots.
Use Safeguard on a ward or minion to dodge Grasping Roots by dashing out of its path.
